items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I never know if Bro would play on. I can't say he did.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess they had a lot of groups wandering, strolling, is what I'm talking about. Serenading bands.
I know I played mandolin. I never know if Bro would play on. I can't say he did.
Well that might have been after you left, because you left so early. Mm-hmm. He might have been out in the country when you were here.
